app.name: Mind Palace
app.tagline: Turn your notes into a walkable memory palace (method of loci)
home.paste: Paste your study notes here (English, Hindi or Marathi)…
home.keyPrivacy: Privacy: your API key is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is sent only to the provider you choose. Your notes leave this device only when you use the AI engine. There is no Mind Palace server.
home.noPalaces: No palaces yet – paste notes or try a sample.
home.deleteConfirm: Delete the palace “{name}” and its progress?
home.how1: Paste notes or upload a PDF. Each key idea becomes a vivid 3D object.
home.how2: Walk the palace in order – the position of each object is a memory hook.
home.how3: Test yourself: put the objects back where they belong. Faded objects tell you what to review.
gen.title: Building your palace
hud.noQuests: Everything is glowing. Nothing to refresh!
hud.tapToOpen: Tap the object to open its card
hud.clickToOpen: Click the object (or press Enter) to open its card
hud.welcome: Welcome to “{name}”. Walk up to an object to learn it.
hud.architectHelp: Architect: drag an object onto another pedestal to swap their places.
card.rateQ: How well did you recall this?
card.wrong: Not quite – the right answer is highlighted.
card.next: Next review in about {d} day(s); fades {w} days after it is due.
card.listening: Listening… say what this object stands for
tour.start: Tour started – follow the guide orb.
recall.title: Recall test
recall.instructions: The objects have left their pedestals. Drag each one back to the spot where you learned it. A wrong spot twice reveals a hint.
recall.newBest: New best! The ghost trail now follows this run (previous best {prev}).
recall.bestWas: Your best is {prev}. Ghost mode keeps following that run.
exam.title: Exam mode
exam.intro: Walk the route through all {n} loci. A question appears at each object. You have {secs} seconds in total. Starting…
settings.timeHelp: Jump forward in time to watch objects fade and refresh quests appear.
settings.clearConfirm: Delete every palace, setting and progress record on this device?
ach.streak3.desc: Studied three days in a row.
ach.perfect_recall.desc: Placed every object correctly on the first try, with no hints.
ach.speed_runner.desc: Scored 80%+ in an exam using less than half the time.
xr.menuHelp: Stick forward = teleport · stick sideways = turn · trigger = select / grab · grip = menu
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.webgl: 3D graphics (WebGL) are not available on this device, so the palace cannot be shown. You can still create and export palaces.
err.xr: Could not start the immersive session on this device.
err.importBad: That file or link is not a valid Mind Palace.
err.noKey: AI engine selected but no API key set – used the offline engine.
err.auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key and provider.
err.rate: Rate limit or quota reached for this API key.
err.network: Network problem – could not reach the AI provider.
err.server: The AI provider returned an error.
err.parse: The AI returned an unusable answer twice.
err.badRequest: The AI provider rejected the request (check the model name).
err.pdfEmpty: No readable text in this PDF (scanned pages are not supported). Paste the text instead.
err.pdfRead: This PDF could not be read.
err.tooShort: Add a few sentences of notes first.
err.tooLarge: That file is larger than 15 MB.
err.noTts: This browser cannot read text aloud.
err.noVoice: No {lang} voice is installed on this device – showing text only.
err.voice.unsupported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser.
